verdict.rationale: Pilot is a bookkeeping and accounting service that handles customer financial data and offers AI answers, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any AI data-use policy. The AI-answers mention describes a feature, not a privacy control.
